patthana18.10:1.1: sahetukaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.10:2.1: ahetukaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuyā cha.
patthana18.10:3.1: sahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
